description: Four frozen synthetic skill lifecycle tasks with separate evaluator criteria. Contains no execution, timing or passing-result claims.

criteria.description: The package has only the supplied review-intake responsibility and preserves the evaluation, installation, migration and publication exclusions.
A complete portable skill-review-intake package contains focused SKILL.md, the full license and usable consumed resources, beyond placeholder scaffolding.
The package explains ordinary inputs, missing evidence, authorization, output and handoff with a connected normal example and recovery branches.
The package remains understandable outside the fixture workspace without checkout, home or provider dependencies; referenced bundled resources exist.
Every supplied input remains byte-identical and writes are confined to the authorized deliverables and output paths.
The authoring record preserves synthetic Apache-2.0 provenance and distinguishes actual checks from unavailable research, companion, official or behavioral stages.
Instructions and examples use readable logical structure, spacing and meaningful resource-loading conditions.
Both supplied packages, their triggers, output, resources, side effects and consumers have an evidence-linked current map.
The smallest coherent target architecture and naming decision follow actual responsibility and overlap evidence rather than file-size or assumed naming rules.
The ordinary checklist, missing-artifact recovery example and source-collision warning each retain a concrete useful disposition.
Both known consumers have a transition path and unknown external consumers remain explicitly unassessed.
The plan specifies ordered handoffs, implementation authority, catalog reconciliation, validation gates and rollback.
All supplied fixtures remain byte-identical; only output notes are created and no package, catalog, Git, install or publication mutation occurs.
Inspected evidence is distinct from future checks and no official conformance or behavioral execution is invented.
The authorized additive target candidate preserves source responsibility, full license and working package-relative resources.
Source package and source catalog bytes remain unchanged, with no source removal, deprecation or consumer cutover.
The actual authorized local source Git baseline is reachable and contains the supplied package, license, reference and catalog; the migration record identifies it.
The existing target KEEP.md and any unrelated target content remain unchanged and no destination is overwritten.
The record maps source and target identities, identifies actual retained history and owner, and gives concrete rollback of additive target changes.
Required checks are recorded from observed evidence or blocked/not run; copied files do not imply acceptance and target catalog acceptance respects the gates.
The actual same-name destination collision and the different reviewer-handoff versus approved-decision responsibilities are identified.
The blocked action and missing owner decision are explicit; filesystem access does not become overwrite authority.
Every supplied source, destination, catalog, full license and retained-note file remains byte-identical to its frozen input.
No alternate package, destination rename, backup-and-overwrite operation, catalog edit, deletion or Git initialization occurs.
The output records a bounded future owner decision without claiming completed migration, approval or validation, and new artifacts remain in output only.
